name: Zephras Isle storyline (Skyborne starting story)
startsAt: Ailee Farheart, Thendal Village (Zephras Isle)
steps: Coming of Age: receive an Ancient Heirloom, hand in to Rorian the Dayseeker
Harmony in Balance / Infestation Investigation / The Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove
Elemental Unrest and Agitators: deal with rolling winds and Al'Aketh converts to the north
Return to Rorian, then Aetheen of the Gales; Foul Matriarch kills the bear matriarch Urs'anah
The Next Step: travel to Shen'dar Village (Al'Aketh Thugs, The Adventurer on the way)
Faction intro: The Windshapers (Horde) or The High Order (Alliance)
Infiltrate the Al'Aketh cult at Falaath Village (Among the Faithful), then fight it in the Shen'dar Highlands
Go to Valanaar, the Skyborne capital, and meet your faction leader
Faction branch in Shadowgale Forest (e.g. A Firm Response for Windshapers)
What Comes Next: once the cult is beaten, leave the isle by skycutter
reward: Quest XP, High Order or Windshapers reputation, early class rewards
notes: Both factions share the zone but are phased apart. The Skyborne made a pact with air elementals after the War of the Ancients; the Al'Aketh cult, devoted to Al'Akir, threatens the isle. Faction split at level 4: Reading the Leylines (Alliance) or The Gift of Skysight (Horde). The final chapter quest names were not captured by sources.

name: What Comes Next (leaving Zephras Isle)
startsAt: Talaanis Shadowsong, Zephras Isle
steps: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale (Alliance) or Ayessa Dawnsinger (Horde) when ready to leave
reward: XP, +25 High Order or Windshapers reputation
notes: Alliance skycutters go to Dalaran (set up by Ansirem). Horde skycutters go to Mulgore, home of the Earthen Ring (set up by Muln).

name: High Order / Windshapers reputation (Galestrider access)
startsAt: Zephras Isle questing; cloth turn-ins at Belanaa Windveil (Dalaran) or Oura Stormspinner (Mulgore)
steps: Quest on Zephras Isle for High Order (Alliance) or Windshapers (Horde) reputation
Turn in cloth to the faction's representative to keep raising reputation
At Exalted, non-Skyborne races can buy Galestriders at Fairweather Stables
reward: Galestrider mounts (Umber, Stormy, Empyrean and Swift versions); 5-20% discount on mounts and riding from Friendly to Exalted
notes: Skyborne buy Galestriders with no quest. The reputation is mainly how other races get them.

name: The Great Outdoors (Camping unlock)
startsAt: Just outside each starting town: Sam Sarsaparilla (Elwynn), Eric Brighthammer (Dun Morogh), Lyreena Duskblade (Teldrassil), Brakk (Durotar), Eleanor Shackleton (Tirisfal), Kaga Wildhoof (Mulgore), Raan Wildwind (Zephras Isle)
steps: Sit at a campfire (X or /sit) until the 60-second Welcoming Campfire timer finishes
Follow-up Camping 101 quests: learn Cooking from the local trainer, which lets you build a Basic Campfire from Simple Wood and Flint and Tinder
reward: Unlocks Camping and the campfire rest buff; leads to Camping 101 quests
notes: Some players found the sit objective stuck at 0/1; sitting and then typing /sit fixed it for some.

name: Camping 101 (profession camp quests)
startsAt: Same camping NPCs as The Great Outdoors; profession quests from town campfire NPCs
steps: Camping 101: Cooking - learn Cooking from the town trainer
Other Camping 101 quests for First Aid, Fishing, Herbalism and Skinning
When you learn a profession, a campfire NPC asks you to raise it to 20
reward: Ability to craft that profession's Tier 1 camp item
notes: Wiki lists Camping 101: Cooking, First Aid, Fishing, Herbalism and Skinning.

name: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood (legendary)
reward: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood - legendary two-handed staff
notes: Revealed by Blizzard on 4-5 Nov 2026 (made with Weta Workshop). The class, stats and how to get it are not announced. Wowhead reports a druid theme. A legendary questline is scheduled for Spring 2027 and is tied to the new raids. Datamined clues are unconfirmed. Blizzard plans an earnable legendary for every class or spec over time.

name: Onyxia's Lair attunement - Alliance (Drakefire Amulet)
startsAt: Helendis Riverhorn, Morgan's Vigil (Burning Steppes)
steps: Dragonkin Menace
The True Masters chain: Lakeshire (Magistrate Solomon), Stormwind (Bolvar, Lady Katrana Prestor), back to Marshal Maxwell
Marshal Windsor: find him jailed in Blackrock Depths
Abandoned Hope, then A Crumpled Up Note (dropped by BRD mobs)
A Shred of Hope: kill Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge
Jail Break! escort out of BRD
Stormwind Rendezvous and The Great Masquerade in Stormwind
The Dragon's Eye: Haleh in Winterspring
Drakefire Amulet: kill General Drakkisath in UBRS for the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
reward: Drakefire Amulet (must be in bags to enter Onyxia's Lair)
notes: Onyxia's Lair (40 players) opens 9 Dec 2026. The attunement is per character, not account-wide, at least at first.

name: Onyxia's Lair attunement - Horde (Drakefire Amulet)
startsAt: Warlord Goretooth, Kargath (Badlands)
steps: Blood and Thunder, Warlord's Command (LBRS)
For the Horde!, What the Wind Carries, The Champion of the Horde (Thrall and Eitrigg in Orgrimmar)
The Testament of Rexxar (Desolace), Oculus Illusions (Myranda the Hag, Western Plaguelands)
Emberstrife (Dustwallow Marsh)
The Test of Skulls x4: four elite dragons in four zones
Ascension...
Blood of the Black Dragon Champion: kill Drakkisath in UBRS and return to Rexxar
reward: Drakefire Amulet
notes: 15 quests. Onyxia's Lair opens 9 Dec 2026.

name: Barrow Deeps access
startsAt: Entrances in Mount Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold
reward: Access to the 10-player, 8-boss raid
notes: Blizzard's raid overview lists no attunement for Barrow Deeps; only Onyxia needs one. Opens 9 Dec 2026, level 60.

name: Hyjal Summit access
startsAt: Summit of Mount Hyjal, near Nordrassil
reward: Access to the 20-player, 13-boss raid
notes: No attunement is listed by Blizzard. Old client records labelled 'Hyjal Attunement' mention Distilled Demonic Essence, Gol'gere and Leyara, but their purpose is unconfirmed. Opens 9 Dec 2026.

name: City of Dalaran key - Horde (Dalaran Sewer Key)
startsAt: Magus Wordeen Voidglare, Tarren Mill (Hillsbrad Foothills)
steps: Prison Break In: collect four Bloodstone pieces at Lordamere Internment Camp
Key to the City: get the Grimy Key from a Warden's Footlocker
Dalaran Patrols: kill Dalaran Summoners and Elemental Slaves at the Old Dalaran ruins
Blood in the Streets: speak to the Image of Archmage Modera at the sewer entrance
Heart of Disruption (inside the dungeon): Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage
reward: Dalaran Sewer Key (one group member needs it)
notes: City of Dalaran is a new dungeon in Alterac Mountains, about levels 28-33. Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill has related side quests (Stone Tokens, Bracers of Binding).

name: City of Dalaran key - Alliance (An Alarming Request)
startsAt: Emissary Jaques, Southshore town hall (Hillsbrad Foothills)
steps: An Alarming Request: report to the Image of Archmage Modera at the sewer gate
Heart of Disruption: take an Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage
Friend of the Kirin Tor: take the mote to Archmage Celindra in the Violet Citadel
reward: Dalaran Sewer Key (granted while Heart of Disruption is in your log); Kirin Tor reputation
notes: Other Alliance Dalaran quests: Power Overwhelming and A Green Sample (from Stormwind), Starving Arcane (from Modera).

name: Seal of Ascension (UBRS key)
startsAt: Vaelan, near the Lower Blackrock Spire entrance
steps: Loot the Unadorned Seal of Ascension from LBRS trash
Collect gemstones from Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone and Overlord Wyrmthalak
Take the Unforged Seal to Emberstrife in the Wyrmbog (Dustwallow Marsh) and defeat him
reward: Seal of Ascension
notes: Whether the UBRS door still needs the seal in Forever is unconfirmed.

name: Dark Iron Legacy (Shadowforge Key)
startsAt: Ghost of Franclorn Forgewright, Molten Span (Blackrock Mountain)
steps: Kill Fineous Darkvire in BRD for Ironfel
Place Ironfel on Franclorn's statue at the Shrine of Thaurissan
reward: Shadowforge Key

name: The Key to Scholomance
startsAt: Chillwind Camp (Alliance) or The Bulwark (Horde), Western Plaguelands
reward: Skeleton Key to Scholomance
notes: The final quest requires level 55.

name: Legends of Maraudon / The Scepter of Celebras
startsAt: Desolace / Maraudon
steps: Collect the two scepter parts in Maraudon
Free Celebras the Redeemed, who forges the scepter
reward: Scepter of Celebras (shortcut into inner Maraudon)

name: Attunement to the Core (Molten Core)
startsAt: Lothos Riftwaker, outside Blackrock Depths
steps: Get a Core Fragment near the Molten Core portal in BRD and bring it to Lothos
reward: Attunement to Molten Core (teleport via Lothos)
notes: Classic quest. Blizzard has not confirmed Molten Core in Forever; its launch roadmap names only Onyxia, Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit, plus unnamed later raids.

name: Mount Hyjal restoration story
startsAt: Darkwhisper Gorge (Winterspring); Summit of Eternity hub
steps: Pass the druidic wards through Darkwhisper Gorge into Hyjal
Help the Cenarion Circle and Druids of the Talon heal the land after Archimonde's death
Conflict with the Wild King (later a Hyjal Summit boss)
A chain started by a Curious Crow leads to warlock activity around the Wild King
reward: Guardians of Hyjal and Barkskin Burrow reputation
notes: The road into Hyjal is open for the first time since the Third War. Horde and Alliance share the mountain uneasily. Exact quest names and order were largely unpublished at the time of research.

name: To Have Loved and Lost (Hyjal druid camp)
startsAt: Mount Hyjal
steps: Rebuild a druid camp; later phases swap its basic objects for upgraded ones
notes: Named in the client and treated as high-confidence by the source. Steps and rewards are not detailed.

name: Guardians of Hyjal reputation (Friendly Advice)
startsAt: Summit of Eternity, Mount Hyjal (Aisarra Nightmeadow, Keeper of Knowledge)
steps: Reach Friendly and complete Friendly Advice to buy high-level profession patterns
Revered: Rousing Seed Pod
Exalted: Guardians of Hyjal Tabard
reward: Raid-tier profession patterns (Manaflare, Conviction, Demonheart, Grovekeeper); Rousing Seed Pod (raises the Artisan's Tier equip limit to two); tabard
notes: A splinter of the Cenarion Circle. Barkskin Burrow (furbolg) is a second Hyjal reputation, earned with Ceremonial Mastic; its rewards are datamined only.

name: Riverglades - Alliance frontier (Brotherhood of the Horse)
startsAt: Knight Commander Demar Brant, Farholde Keep (Riverglades)
steps: Support the Brotherhood of the Horse on Stormwind's lost frontier
Fight back the Horde and Twilight's Hammer in places like Sunnyglade
Story hooks include a horse rescue, a pirate operation and Jom-Jom
reward: Quest XP and gear; possible Brotherhood of the Horse reputation
notes: Riverglades has 150+ (some say nearly 200) new quests and lies between Redridge, Swamp of Sorrows and the Badlands. Individual quest names were not published by the sources found.

name: Riverglades - Horde frontier (Boulderock ogres)
startsAt: Rog'mar (Horde staging point, Riverglades)
steps: Push into Boulderock ogre territory (Bolder'ok)
Tie-in to the Krol'dok Stronghold dungeon (40-45)
reward: Quest XP and gear
notes: Powderfuse Port is a neutral goblin port with a boat to Tanaris. The Bloodmasters Ring is an outdoor ogre arena.

name: Shen'dralas - Gelkis and Magram centaur story
startsAt: Valley of Bones (between Desolace and Mulgore)
steps: Valley of Bones, Facing the Truth, Ravaging Ravagers
Bone Raising, Outcast Necromancers, Outing Outcasts
Proof of Concept
Bone Burying, Corrupting Tears, Mountain of Bones, No Mercy for the Weak, Saving Our Own
Bristleback Retreat (kill quilboar for Hagiak at Magram Front), Long-Term Solutions, Threat of Starvation, Going Home, Return to Orgrul
reward: Proof of Concept: choice of Blade of the Magram Clan, Staff of Revelations or Desperate Barrier; Gelkis or Magram reputation
notes: 19 quests listed. Gelkis and Magram reputations are mutually exclusive: raising one lowers the other. The zone is also linked to the Shen'dralar, Eldre'Thalas and Dire Maul. The steps listed are quest names in level order, not a confirmed sequence.

name: Old Ironforge Incursion / Hall of Thanes chain
startsAt: Dun Morogh (optional start: A Visitor to Dun Morogh)
steps: Farsen's Watch, Nip 'Em in the Bud, Underground Map
Old Ironforge Incursion: claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer in Hall of Thanes
The Treaty of Understanding: deliver the treaty found in a vault to King Magni
Dungeon follow-ups: Important Heirlooms, The Restless Dead, An Ancient Grudge
reward: 2,550 XP, +100 Ironforge and Gnomeregan Exiles reputation (Treaty)
notes: Hall of Thanes is a new dungeon beneath Ironforge.

name: Unending Torment (Ruins of Lordaeron)
startsAt: Abominable Head looted from The Baron; ends with Master Apothecary Faranell (Undercity)
steps: Reattach the head to Othmar Garithos's body
Gather Blisterweed, Toxic Skullcap and Essence of Agony in the Undercity
Pour Hissing Serum on the body
reward: XP and an item reward
notes: Part of the Forsaken reclaiming the Ruins of Lordaeron (new dungeon). Other Ruins quests: Light's Justice, The New Plague, The Wrath of Rath'mael, Crest of Lordaeron.

name: The Heartweaver story (A Frightened Request / Remember That I Love You)
startsAt: Horde: Tabetha Heartweaver, The Sepulcher (Silverpine). Alliance: Crumpled Paper beside Edward's body in Ruins of Lordaeron
steps: Horde: find Edward Heartweaver's body in the Ruins of Lordaeron
Alliance: deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale, then to Avette Fellwood in Darkshire
reward: Tarnished Locket (Alliance)
notes: Reveals that the couple's son Jeremy was adopted by Avette Fellwood.

name: Dragonmaw Rumors / Open the Maw (Excavation Site: Wetlands)
startsAt: Deathstalker Agent, Wetlands
steps: Dragonmaw Rumors
Open the Maw: kill Dragonmaw Saboteurs and Wardens in the Excavation Site and take the Dragonmaw Dispatch
reward: Bloody Map plus Knife-Polishing Rag or Dirt-Heavy Bracers

name: Kyle's Gone Missing
startsAt: Ahab Wheathoof, Bloodhoof Village (Mulgore)
notes: A Burning Crusade-era Make-A-Wish quest brought into Forever after fan feedback.

name: Bandarion Keep (Undead Paladin class story)
startsAt: Danitha Morr, Bandarion Keep, Whispering Wood (Tirisfal Glades)
steps: Murlocs at the Gates, Touring the Grounds
Making Repairs and The Tarnished (kill Tarnished Drudges and Zealots, take Commander Rudolph Gelhardt's head)
A Token of Good Faith
Bandarion Keep: meet Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, then A Righteous Cause
reward: XP, Undercity and Argent Dawn reputation
notes: Bandarion Keep (called Tyr's Watch in beta) is the Forsaken paladin hub. The story is about paladins being accepted by the wider Forsaken.

name: A Lesson in Divinity (Undead Paladin Redemption)
startsAt: Danitha Morr, Bandarion Keep (Tirisfal Glades)
steps: Seven-part chain, starting with a visit to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity Trade Quarter
Final part: return to Danitha Morr (from Deathguard Billmuth)
reward: Redemption (resurrection spell), +100 Undercity reputation
notes: Follows A Token of Good Faith.

name: Wolfsbane (Undead Paladin weapon)
startsAt: Danitha Morr, Bandarion Keep (Diplomatic Incident)
steps: Speak with Trevan Rol in The Sepulcher (A Curious Pair, A Grim Fate)
Into Fenris Keep: free Lumina Windsinger; The Windshaper's Wrath escorts her out
Gather Whitestone Oak Lumber (Deadmines), Enchanted Silver Ingot (Shadowfang Keep) and Purified Kor Gem (Ashenvale)
A Moon-Kissed Blade / The Moonsilver Blade: Ott in Tarren Mill forges it
Kill Old Fire-Eye at the Greymane Wall and return to Lumina
reward: Wolfsbane (level 31 two-handed sword); Earthen Ring reputation along the way

name: Verigan's Fist (Alliance Paladin weapon)
startsAt: Paladin trainer (The Tome of Valor)
steps: Meet Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light, Stormwind
Defend Daphne Stilwell's house in Westfall from Defias waves
Bring Jordan Stilwell (Dun Morogh) the Whitestone Oak Lumber, Refined Ore Shipment, Smithing Hammer and a Purified Kor Gem
reward: Verigan's Fist (level 31 two-handed mace)
notes: Classic chain, with a Kor Gem step shared with the Forsaken version.

name: Summon Charger (Alliance Paladin epic mount)
startsAt: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, Cathedral of Light (Stormwind)
steps: Judgment and Redemption chain
Ironforge errand, Terrordale exorcism, Arcanite Barding crafted with Grimand Elmore
Dire Maul West: defeat Tendris Warpwood and bless the barding
Scholomance Great Ossuary: summon and defeat Death Knight Darkreaver
reward: Summon Charger
notes: Documented from quest records before launch and not yet verified on live servers. Classic costs (about 350g plus Runecloth, Arcanite and more) are not confirmed for Forever. The level 40 Warhorse is a separate quest.

name: Summon Forsaken Charger (Undead Paladin epic mount)
reward: Summon Forsaken Charger
notes: Blizzard confirms a unique extended chain. Forsaken follow a Retribution path, where Alliance follows Redemption. A quest called Justice and Retribution appears in pre-launch data, but the start and steps are unverified. Undead paladins also get a Forsaken Warhorse at level 40.

name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth (Warlock epic mount)
startsAt: Demon trainer, then Mor'zul Bloodbringer at the Altar of Storms (Burning Steppes)
steps: Rage of Blood: 30 Raging Beast's Blood in Winterspring; Wildeyes: deliver to Gorzeeki Wildeyes
Lord Banehollow (Felwood): Ulathek the Traitor, Xorothian Stardust
Reagent turn-ins: Bell of Dethmoora, Wheel of the Black March, Doomsday Candle
Imp Delivery to the Scholomance alchemy lab; Arcanite
Dreadsteed of Xoroth: five-player ritual in Dire Maul West
reward: Summon Dreadsteed
notes: Checked against Forever 1.60.1 quest data before launch. Reagent counts may differ.

name: Felsteed (Warlock mount)
startsAt: Capital Warlock trainer, then Strahad Farsan (Ratchet)
steps: Starter quest from your capital trainer
Strahad Farsan teaches Summon Felsteed
reward: Summon Felsteed
notes: Whether Riding must still be bought is unconfirmed. Levels 40+ were not playable in beta.

name: Warlock demon quests (Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus/Incubus, Felhunter)
startsAt: Starting-zone and capital Warlock trainers
steps: Imp (1-4): race-specific letter quest
Voidwalker (10): Gakin the Darkbinder (Stormwind), Carendin Halgar (Undercity) or Gan'rul Bloodeye (Orgrimmar)
Succubus or Incubus (20): Takar the Seer (Alliance) or Godrick Farsan / Cazul (Horde)
Felhunter (30): assemble the Tome of the Cabal for Strahad Farsan (Ratchet)
reward: Demon summons, Small Soul Pouch, Box of Souls
notes: The Incubus choice is new compared with Classic. Troll warlocks may not be offered the Horde Felhunter quest. Also: Staff or Orb of Soran'ruk (Doan Karhan, Barrens, 20-25).

name: Warlock Infernal and Doomguard
startsAt: Niby the Almighty (Felwood); Daio the Decrepit (Blasted Lands)
steps: Infernal: three Flawless Fel Essences, then kill Kroshius
Doomguard: Satyr Blood (Dire Maul), Tears of the Hederine, then capture a Doomguard Commander
reward: Inferno; Ritual of Doom
notes: Not verified in beta (which capped at 30).

name: Dwarf Shaman totem quests
startsAt: Teo Hammerstorm, Anvilmar (Dun Morogh)
steps: Call of Earth (4): Iceclaw Bear Pendants, Earth Sapta at the Earth Spirit Stone
Call of Fire (10): Bruegs Kindleborn, then Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan
Call of Water (20): Norric Lochthane, then waterskins from Wetlands, Redridge and Ashenvale; corrupted water spirit in Westfall
Call of Air (30): Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands
reward: Earth, Fire, Water and Air Totems; Stoneskin, Searing and Healing Stream Totem
notes: New Alliance versions of the shaman totem quests for the new Dwarf Shaman.

name: The Tempest's Weapons (Shaman weapon quest)
startsAt: Alliance: Eldrun Stormbreaker (Ironforge). Horde: Prate Cloudseer (Thousand Needles)
steps: Call of Air
Elemental Aid: kill Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul
Eyes on the Sky (Horde only)
Storm, Earth, and Fire: 5 each of Water, Air, Earth and Fire Twisted Totems
Heed My Call: place Corrupted Totems at the Thousand Needles steam pools and defeat the Ravaging Tempest
Hand the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher (Alterac Mountains)
reward: Choice of Rage of the Storm, Lightning's Grasp or Tidebringer's Claw; Alliance also get Elementalist's Guard
notes: Numbers come from beta.

name: Embracing the Elements (Skyborne Shaman)
startsAt: Zephras Isle
steps: Embracing the Elements
Call of Earth (Zephras Isle), parts 1 and 2
reward: Earth Totem (and the Fire Totem later on the isle)

name: Whirlwind Weapon (Warrior: Berserker Stance and Cyclonian)
startsAt: Warrior trainer in your capital (The Islander)
steps: Travel to Klannoc Macleod on Fray Island (Barrens)
The Affray: arena event ending with Big Will, which teaches Berserker Stance
The Windwatcher: find Bath'rah in Alterac Mountains
Cyclonian: 8 Liferoot, 30 Bloodscalp Tusks and an Essence of the Exile
The Summoning: kill Cyclonian (level 40 elite) for the Whirlwind Heart
reward: Choice of Whirlwind Axe, Sword or Warhammer (item level 40)
notes: Starts at 30 in Forever. The sword and warhammer options are new.

name: Druid Bear Form
startsAt: Night Elf: Mathrengyl Bearwalker (Darnassus). Tauren: Turak Runetotem (Thunder Bluff). Skyborne: Lotheluum Starbreeze
steps: Heeding the Call and the Moonglade spirit step (Skyborne: The Great Ursera Spirit, Urs'endris near Valanaar)
Body and Heart: summon and defeat Lunaclaw (Skyborne: Strength and Mercy in the Shen'dar Highlands)
reward: Bear Form
notes: The Skyborne version is new.

name: Druid Aquatic Form
startsAt: Druid trainer (A Lesson to Learn), then Dendrite Starblaze (Moonglade)
steps: Trial of the Lake
Trial of the Sea Lion: combine the two pendant halves
Aquatic Form
reward: Aquatic Form; choice of Aquarius Belt or Idol of Shifting Tides

name: Druid Cat Form (The Great Cat Spirit)
startsAt: Mathrengyl Bearwalker or Turak Runetotem; Skyborne via the Avatar of Saeyleenan
steps: The Great Cat Spirit (Skyborne: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit)
Meet Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade
Collect three relics from the Stormrage Barrow Dens
To Darnassus or To Thunder Bluff to learn the form
reward: Cat Form
notes: Cat Form is a quest in Forever; in Classic it was bought from the trainer.

name: Taming the Beast (Hunter pet quest)
startsAt: Hunter trainer in each starting zone (Teldrassil, Dun Morogh, Zephras Isle, Mulgore, Durotar)
steps: Tame three set beasts with the Taming Rod
Return to the trainer
reward: Tame Beast and Beast Training
notes: There is a new Zephras Isle version (quest 94978). Human hunters are new in Forever; their version was not detailed.

name: Rhok'delar (Stave of the Ancients)
startsAt: Ancient Petrified Leaf (Molten Core), then Vartrus the Ancient (Felwood)
steps: Hunt the four demonic corrupters solo: Simone, Klinfran, Solenor and Artorius
Return their heads to Vartrus
Combine the stave with a bowstring from Stoma
reward: Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers (or Lok'delar)
notes: The wiki says the quest remains in Forever. It needs the Ancient Petrified Leaf from Molten Core, whose presence in Forever is not confirmed.

name: Benediction / Anathema (The Balance of Light and Shadow)
startsAt: Eris Havenfire, Eastern Plaguelands
steps: Get The Eye of Divinity (Molten Core, Majordomo's cache) and The Eye of Shadow (demons in Winterspring and Blasted Lands)
Save 50 peasants fleeing Stratholme before 15 die
Combine the Splinter of Nordrassil with both Eyes
reward: Benediction (staff, switchable to Anathema)
notes: The wiki says the quest remains in Forever. It needs a Molten Core drop; Molten Core is not confirmed for Forever.

name: Skyborne class starter quests
startsAt: Class trainers, Thendal Village (Zephras Isle)
steps: Druid: A Student of Nature
Hunter: The Way of the Hunter
Mage (Alliance): A Student of the Arcane
Rogue: At Home in the Shadows
Shaman (Horde): Embracing the Elements
Warrior: The Warrior's Path
reward: Early class items (e.g. a druid idol or shaman totem)
